text:
Maya: quick heads-up — i'm about to merge an infra PR that disables automountServiceAccountToken on tenant-telemetry pods to reduce token exposure. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2795
Sam: does the uploader initContainer still need a SA token? last time it used a projected token for IRSA exchange.
Maya: yes, uploader init runs creds-fetcher which exchanges the SA token with STS. the current terraform change flips automount off at the pod template level.
ops-bot: terraform plan snippet:
```
module.tenant_telemetry.kubernetes_deployment.telemetry[0]:
  ~ spec[0].template[0].spec[0].automount_service_account_token: "true" => "false"
```
Devin: two safe routes: (A) projected serviceAccountToken volume mounted into the initContainer (keeps pod-level automount off), or (B) run a short init Job that uses a dedicated ServiceAccount annotated for IRSA. note: serviceAccountName is pod-scoped, you can't set it per-container.
Sam: ah yeah thanks — i earlier suggested setting serviceAccountName on the init only which is wrong.
Devin: projection example to add under the helm chart (guard behind a value):
```yaml
volumes:
- name: init-sa-token
  projected:
    sources:
    - serviceAccountToken:
        audience: sts.amazonaws.com
        path: token
        expirationSeconds: 600
volumeMounts:
- name: init-sa-token
  mountPath: /var/run/secrets/init-token
  readOnly: true
```
init reads /var/run/secrets/init-token/token
Lisa: heads-up — our image-signing admission webhook in some staging clusters stripped projected sources when automount was false last year. we must validate projection on staging (k8s 1.22/1.23 matrix) before canary. helm change should be toggle-able.
Maya: proposal: implement projected token behind charts/telemetry/values.enableInitTokenProjection (default true). if projection fails in staging, fallback is an init Job that runs with telemetry-init-sa (annotated for IRSA).
Sam: if we create telemetry-init-sa annotate with eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/telemetry-init-role — IRSA only works if annotation sits on the SA resource used to mint the token.
Devin: projection wins from security POV (scoped file + short expiry) but depends on kubelet TokenRequest and webhook compatibility. Job approach is operationally simpler.
Lisa: also update charts/telemetry/templates/deployment.yaml to conditionally include volumes + mounts; add docs in charts/telemetry/README.md about enableInitTokenProjection.
Maya: i'll open a follow-up PR to: add telemetry-init-sa manifest (with IRSA annotation), add helm values and template fragments for projection, and add an optional init Job manifest as fallback. testing plan: deploy to staging-telemetry, tail init logs, validate STS exchange and S3 calls, confirm primary containers have automount disabled.
Maya: tagging @eng-sre for a staging window tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT. i'll post PR links back here when ready.
ops-bot: CI: infra/checks passed for PR #2795 and branch 2795-init-proj
Maya: thanks everyone — will post followup PR in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
